note: RGB WCT strength=0.3 on top of latent WCT ll05. DINO-S dropped from 0.4614 to 0.4364 (-0.0250). RGB-space postprocessing consistently harmful to DINO CLS features.

VGG Gram style optimization (5 steps, lr=0.02) on top of WCT ll05. DINO-S dropped from 0.4614 to 0.4472 (-0.0142). Iterative VGG optimization in RGB space destroys latent WCT statistics. All RGB-space methods (AdaIN, WCT, VGG-opt) consistently harmful. Latent WCT ceiling confirmed at 0.4614-0.4617.

Style amplification factor=2.0 on cross-attention delta. DINO-S dropped from 0.4614 to 0.4479 (-0.0135). Inference-time style signal amplification (both input-side extrap and attention-output amplification) consistently harmful. DINO-S is sensitive to style signal strength — trained gate value is optimal. Infra I3.1 cache benchmark: 14.1% speedup, 8.9s saved per 750 images, output diff=0.00.

WCT covariance interpolation beta=0.7 (30% content + 70% style covariance). DINO-S dropped from 0.4614 to 0.4478 (-0.0136). Mixing content covariance into style target dilutes style signal. Critical finding: both amplifying style signal (S4 amp20=-0.0135) and diluting style signal (S5 cov07=-0.0136) hurt DINO-S equally. Trained WCT at beta=1.0 is at local optimum — any perturbation in either direction degrades DINO-S. Latent WCT ceiling confirmed at 0.4614-0.4617.

WCT covariance interpolation beta=0.5 (50% content + 50% style covariance). DINO-S=0.4478, identical to beta=0.7 (0.4478). Both beta values converge to same floor. All perturbation directions (amplify S4=0.4479, dilute S5=0.4478) converge to ~0.4478, which is S0 baseline + 0.0057. DINO-S=0.5 NOT achievable through inference-time statistical manipulation. Latent WCT ceiling definitively confirmed at 0.4614-0.4617.

Phase T1: Adaptive Style Gate (ASG). gate_map = tanh(style_gate + MLP(content_features)). Zero-init MLP, 5 epochs, batch=24. DINO-S=0.4843 is the HIGHEST EVER recorded, breaking the previous 0.4617 inference-time ceiling by +0.0226. DINO-C=0.7692 (+0.0741 vs S0), LPIPS=0.3354 (-0.1277, much better content). CLIP-S=0.7261 (nearly unchanged, -0.0037). ASG theory confirmed: content-dependent spatial gate breaks style-content trade-off. Train: 23s/epoch, 5 epochs total ~2min. VRAM: 2.91GB.

Phase T2: Frequency-aware ASG (per-subband gate). Independent gates for LH/HL/HH subbands before iDWT. gate_i = tanh(style_gate_i + MLP_i(content_subband_i)). DINO-S=0.4833, micro-drop -0.0010 vs T1 ASG (0.4843). DINO-C=0.7654 (-0.0038), LPIPS=0.3401 (+0.0047). Conclusion: per-subband gate differentiation is NOT the bottleneck — unified scalar gate + spatial self-adaptation already captures the main gain. Train: 22.6s/epoch, 904,300 params (+1K vs T1). VRAM: 2.96GB.

Phase T4: Adaptive WCT scales on T1 ASG checkpoint (inference-only, no retraining). per_subband_wct with content/style energy ratio adjusting per-subband WCT scales (ratio clamped 0.5-2.0, scale clamped 0.0-1.0). DINO-S=0.4801 (-0.0042 vs T1 ASG). DINO-C=0.6123 (-0.1569, SEVERE content destruction). LPIPS=0.5341 (+0.1987, severe content loss). CLIP-S=0.7264 (+0.0003, neutral). Root cause: per_subband_wct applies full-covariance WCT to ALL subbands including LL (scale=0.5), destroying content structure. Adaptive ratio adjustment (0.5-2.0 range) insufficient to mitigate WCT aggressiveness. Conclusion: full-covariance WCT on content-carrying subbands is fundamentally harmful to DINO-C and LPIPS. T1 ASG without inference-time WCT postprocess remains optimal.
